## About

I am a Kuwait-based AI and digital transformation consultant, living and working in Kuwait since 2009. For more than 15 years I have worked where business meets technology: IT and network administration, IT consulting, digital media and marketing, and, since 2022, digital solutions and AI.

That path matters. The technical foundation means I build and run systems myself; the marketing years mean I think about the people who will use a solution as much as the technology behind it.

Over the past 12 months I have been delivering AI solutions for large enterprises and public-sector organisations: AI avatar and assistant systems, document-intelligence and legal-content portals, AI model gateways and process automation agents.

## Services

Three ways to work together, from deciding where AI fits to building it and keeping it under control.

### AI readiness & strategy

Outcome: A clear view of where AI fits your business and what to do first.

We look at your processes, data and systems together, identify where AI is worth applying, and agree a prioritised plan your management stands behind.

- Use-case and opportunity workshops
- Data and systems readiness review
- Prioritised plan with clear scope
- Build, buy or partner recommendations

### AI solution build & delivery

Outcome: Working AI solutions connected to the systems you already use.

I design and build the solution with your team, in Arabic and English, and connect it to your existing platforms.

- AI assistants and avatar systems
- Document intelligence and content portals
- Process automation agents
- Integration with existing systems

### AI governance & model gateways

Outcome: AI use that stays secure, visible and within budget.

A controlled layer between your applications and the AI models they use, so management decides which models are used, by whom, and at what cost.

- AI model gateway design and setup
- Choice of commercial and open models
- Access control and usage visibility
- Cost control across models and teams

### Who it is for

I work with mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with mature management, who value quality and clear accountability over the lowest price.

## Process

A clear, four-step process, with management involved at every decision point.

1. Discover: A conversation about your goals, constraints and where AI could help. You leave with a clearer view, whether or not we work together.
2. Design: We agree the scope, the success criteria, the models to use and where your data is processed.
3. Build: I build and integrate the solution in short, visible stages, so you see progress and can adjust early.
4. Hand over & improve: Your team takes the solution into daily use with clear documentation, and we refine it based on real usage.

## What he builds

Over the past 12 months I have delivered these types of AI solutions for large enterprises and public-sector organisations. Client names and details stay confidential.

### AI avatar and assistant systems

Conversational assistants, including on-screen AI avatars, that answer questions from an organisation's own approved content.

- Arabic and English conversations
- Answers drawn from approved sources
- Connected to existing channels and systems

### Document-intelligence and legal-content portals

Portals that organise large bodies of documents, including legal content, so people can find, read and question them quickly.

- Search and questions in plain language
- Structured navigation of legal content
- Review steps where accuracy matters

### AI model gateways

A single, controlled entry point between an organisation's applications and the AI models they use.

- One access point for several models
- Access control and usage visibility
- Cost control by team or use case

### Process automation agents

AI agents that take on repetitive steps in a business process and hand over to people where judgement is needed.

- Built around existing workflows
- Human approval at defined points
- Connected to the systems already in use

### My own AI operations stack

I do not only advise on these systems; I built and run my own. My daily work runs on an AI operations stack I operate myself:

- Persistent AI memory: A knowledge system that keeps context and decisions available across work sessions.
- Self-hosted secrets management: Credentials and keys kept on infrastructure I control.
- Self-hosted web intelligence: A crawling service that gathers and structures web information.
- Multi-model orchestration: Claude, Codex/GPT and open models working together, with cost control.

## FAQ

### Who do you work with?

Mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with mature management, who value quality over price. My recent delivery work has been for large enterprises and public-sector organisations, and I bring the same standard to mid-sized companies.

### How do engagements usually work?

We start with a discovery call. From there, the first step is usually either a readiness and strategy phase or a clearly defined build. Each phase has its own scope and is agreed separately, so you only commit to the next step.

### Do your solutions work in Arabic?

Yes. I work in Arabic and English, and solutions are designed for both languages from the start, including Arabic content and right-to-left interfaces.

### How do you handle data security? Can the solution be self-hosted?

Where your data is processed and who can access it are agreed in the design step, in line with your internal policies. Self-hosting is part of that discussion: I run self-hosted components in my own operations stack, including secrets management and a web-intelligence service.

### Which AI models do you work with?

I work with several model families, including Claude, Codex/GPT and open models. The choice depends on the task, your data requirements and cost, and an AI model gateway lets you use more than one without being tied to a single provider.

### How do you keep AI costs under control?

Through governance built into the design: an AI model gateway gives management visibility of usage and control over which models are used for what. I run the same kind of cost control across models in my own work.

### How do we get started?

Request a discovery call on WhatsApp. We discuss your goals and current situation, and I suggest a sensible first step.
